热情而大方的餐厅制服，芙拉薇娅用以潜伏于某家街边小馆中。迎着美丽的日落，享受着伊比利亚式的醇香与美味，芙拉薇娅和客人们一同沉浸在这种浪漫的情调中。

Desc.SourceString:

"It's nice to soak up some sun occasionally. The pool party was fun; next time, how about joining me at the beach?"

Desc.SourceString:
霓之城的午夜电台迎来了一位特殊的主持，蝴蝶的翅脉又将在这灯火辉煌的不夜城掀起怎样的声浪呢？

【“清除这座城市的罪恶，就拿你们作为蝴蝶效应的第一循吧。”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
A special host joins the midnight radio station of Neon City. What waves will the butterfly stir up in the dazzling city that never sleeps?

“To cleanse the city of its sins, you will serve as the first cycle of the butterfly effect.”

Desc.SourceString:
作为新人搜查官的芙拉薇娅，因为自身特殊的弦能力，常被派去执行特工任务。她的所到之处，都会留下关于紫色幻蝶的传说。

【“啊，又受了点伤……还需要更加熟练一点才行啊。”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
As a rookie investigator, Flavia is often sent on special missions due to her unique abilities. Everywhere she goes, she leaves behind the legend of the mystical purple butterflies.

"Ah, injured again... I've got to get better at this."

Desc.SourceString:
传说中永夜古堡的主人，永生不灭、已在世上存活了数千年的貌美女子——芙拉薇娅。当天空中黑月升起，灵蝶会送来古堡的邀请函，此为邀约，亦是试探。

【“我既不吸食人血，也不惧怕阳光，如果对我真的如此好奇，不如亲自来看一看？”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
Legend tells of Flavia, the immortal mistress of the Castle of Eternal Night, a stunning beauty who has existed for millennia. When the black moon ascends, a spirit butterfly carries the castle's invitation—a challenge and a test.

"I neither drink blood nor fear sunlight. If you're truly curious, why not see for yourself?"

【“若你见我，无需惊惧，我是指引，是仅为黎明闪耀的极星。”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
Designed by P.U.S for Flavia, this combat suit draws inspiration from the Expedition Plan. It boasts an elegant style, facilitating her smooth transition between Watcher and Judge.

"If you see me, fear not. I guide as the North Star, shining only for dawn."

如果对着月亮虔诚祈祷的话，月光女神就会回应你的呼唤。对待虔诚的信徒，她播撒恩赐；对投机取巧的小人，她降下神罚——这是这个世界的孩子们从小听着长大的童话故事。

【“神明造物，亦有物造的神明。我诞生于信仰，生命未有消亡，我便会永生。”】

"Divine creations and creations of the divine. Born from faith, as long as belief endures, so shall I."

Desc.LocalizedString: Eika's fast food uniform. This unique combo of a school and staff attire, helps her look the part and complements her youthful style. Rumor is that the dripping red feature was inspired by Eika's mournful experience of accidentally spilling chili sauce all over a big plate of chicken nuggets.

Desc.LocalizedString: Eika wears this uniform when working part-time at the game store. It's accented with the color scheme of a popular gaming console. Promoting games is part of the job, so Eika often competes with pro gamers. It's become quite the attraction.

Desc.LocalizedString: Eika's uniform for her farm job. Based on a basic work uniform, it blends elements of meadow green and earthy tones. Her cheerful presence is a hit at the farm, even attracting the farm's robotic herding dog. Are they playing a friendly game... or is Eika simply afraid of dogs?

【“女高中生的一天，在放学之后才算真正开始！”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
Eika’s self-styled outdoor gear showcases bold and edgy fashion that embodies the wild spirit of a high school girl. Exactly where she "lets loose" after school is her little secret.

“The day of a high school student only begins after school!”

艾卡在天文馆兼职搬运工作时的服装，由她本人亲自搭配，集合了各种科幻电影的要素，以及少女对星海的浪漫想象。在天文馆的氛围中，艾卡忽然觉得，能做上宇宙送货员或许是一件很酷的事情。

【“如果咱家的餐馆遍布了全宇宙，我是不是得在各个星球之间送外卖啊？”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
Eika put together this outfit for her side job at the planetarium, blending elements from sci-fi movies with a girl's dreamy imagination of the stars. While working inside the planetarium, Eika realizes that being a galactic courier could be the coolest job ever.

"If our family restaurant spanned the universe, would I have to deliver food among planets?"

【“想一睹被焚风染红的海底吗？”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
This summer sea is unlikely to stay calm, with Flicker Fin making a dazzling entrance. Their fiery passion stirs a vibrant storm beneath the waves.

"Care to witness the seabed painted red by scorching winds?"

【“虽然总是用面具来遮掩表情，但是艾卡对粉丝的一片真心，你们能感受到吧？”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
Eika's exclusive idol costume. The bunny on her mask might be soft and cuddly, but the plaid puffy skirt and tank top give a real rockstar vibe. Just what kind of expression could this idol's mask be hiding?

"My face may be hidden behind a mask, but you can feel my sincerity, right?"

【“火焰将净化，并疗愈一切。”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
In a world free of physical ailments, there are healers for the heart. The Scissors are known as radicals. And so, a regular high school girl must still conceal her true "identity."

"Fire purifies. Fire heals all."

【“为了获得新的力量，有时我们需要烧毁旧的躯壳。”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
Her flames burn hotter than the desert sands. As she moves, ashes rise, heralding an incoming wave of heat.

“One must burn the old shell to gain new strength.”

【“哈哈哈哈，我这身打扮确实不错呢，应该能吓到你们吧！还有，我的名字是‘艾卡’，不是什么‘给糖大使’也不是‘捣蛋小姐’，只是把参赛宣言和名字写反了而已……”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
"Trick or Treat" took home the Best Visual Award in the Spookfest parade by popular vote. Who is she? Merely passing by—it's Eika! Combining a charming pumpkin mask with her striking figure, she became a visual sensation and the most photographed of the day.

"Haha, love my outfit? Bet I spooked you! By the way, I'm not the 'Candy Ambassador' or 'Trickster Girl'—just mixed up my entry slogan and name..."

Desc.SourceString:
手捧托盘的女仆笑意款款，即使透过遮挡的面具，也能感受到她的欢欣与得意。很明显手上的糖果屋是她的得意之作，只是看上去有些过于甜蜜了……

【“来到庄园，就是我们尊贵的客人了！这份见面礼就收下吧，你可一定要全部吃完啊！”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
With a tray in hand, the maid offers a cheerful smile. Her delight and pride are evident, even behind the mask. The candy house she's holding is her prized creation, though it seems a bit too sugary...

"Welcome to the manor! Please accept this welcome gift, and make sure to eat it all!"

SellDesc.LocalizedString: <HermesSellDesc>Are you sure you want to buy this outfit?</>

Desc.SourceString:
女高中生的假日，当然要在游乐园度过！为赴玛德雷娜之约，艾卡设计了新的服装，戴上了小怪兽帽子、背上了喷火龙背包。有这两个小家伙帮忙，今天无论是打气球、抓娃娃还是捞金鱼，她都不会输的！

【“无敌的艾卡大王，在游乐园也战无不胜！”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
For a high schooler, the amusement park is the perfect holiday spot! Eika put together an outfit with a cute monster hat and dragon backpack for her day with Maddelena. Armed with her playful sidekicks, she's ready to conquer any park game!

"Eika the Invincible reigns undefeated!"

Desc.SourceString:
艾卡是冒险者公会的新成员。任谁也想不到，那怪异的兽骨面具之下，竟藏着一张可爱稚气的脸庞。初来乍到的她选择在这里接取委托、交换情报，偶尔也帮忙干些杂活。

【“欢迎来到冒险者公会！别看我打扮得有点奇怪，我做的饭超级好吃哦！”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
Eika is a new member of the Adventurers' Guild. Beneath a peculiar beast-bone mask lies a cute, innocent face. She's here to take on quests, exchange info, and lend a hand with odd jobs.

"Welcome to the guild! I may look odd, but my meals are delicious!"

Desc.SourceString:
任何时间，任何地点，任何困难，都会为你解决！照亮普雷顿之心的火焰，蓄势于日珥装甲之中，静待时机，一飞冲天。

【“‘英雄’……在说我吗？嘿嘿，终于等到这个从小向往的头衔落在我头上啦。不过，内心居然没有很激动？大概是守护普雷顿的信念，早已与‘艾卡’融为一体了吧！”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
Ready to tackle any challenge, anywhere, anytime. The fire that lights up Preton resides within the Solar Armor, waiting for the perfect moment to soar.

"Am I really the 'hero' they're talking about? Hehe, I've dreamed of this title forever. Strange though, I'm not as thrilled as I imagined. Maybe it's because the passion to protect Preton has always been part of who I am!"

Desc.SourceString:
“每种咖啡豆都有不同的香味呢。”珐格兰丝把面前的咖啡杯推到艾卡面前，“这一款闻起来有花香和果香，应该会很好喝。”
“果香？是水果那样甜甜的味道吗！……哇哇哇好酸！！！”
Desc.LocalizedString:
"Each type of coffee bean has a unique aroma." Fragrans places the cup of coffee in front of Eika. "This one has floral and fruity notes. It should be delightful."

"Really? Like, as sweet as fruit?... Ah! It's so sour!!!"

Desc.SourceString:
春天是珐格兰丝最喜欢的季节，万物复苏，生机盎然。
“今年的第一款香氛，就制作樱花香味的吧。”
Desc.LocalizedString:
Spring, full of vitality and renewal, is Fragrans' favorite season.

"Let's make the first fragrance of this year a sakura scent."

SellDesc.SourceString: <HermesSellDesc>您是否确定解锁该角色时装?</>

Desc.SourceString:
在剪刀手一行人的古堡探险挑战中，最快走出来的居然是戴着眼罩的珐格兰丝。
“蝙蝠用回声定位，我用味道定位……古堡外的空气，确实要更清新一些呢。”
Desc.LocalizedString:
During The Scissors' castle exploration, Fragrans, to everyone's surprise, was the fastest to emerge, even with a blindfold on.
"Bats use sound; I use scent... The air outside the castle is indeed much fresher."

SellDesc.SourceString: <HermesSellDesc>您是否确定解锁该角色时装?</>
SellDesc.LocalizedString: <HermesSellDesc>Are you sure you want to buy this outfit?</>

Desc.SourceString:
在和剪刀手的其他伙伴一起参观完水族馆后，珐格兰丝给自己制作了一件以水母为主题的装扮。
“水母……像盛开在海底，幽蓝的花。”
Desc.LocalizedString:
After an aquarium trip with her friends, Fragrans made herself a jellyfish-themed outfit.
"Jellyfish... they strike me as light blue flowers blooming on the seabed."

Desc.SourceString: 珐格兰丝探访香雪海时穿着的服装。雪光如昼的冬日，梅花如期盛放在她飞舞的衣角上，弥散出了一缕幽香。
Desc.LocalizedString: The outfit Fragrans wore when visiting the Sea of Blossoms. On that snowy day, plum blossoms bloomed on the corners of her fluttering clothes, covering her in their faint scent.

SellDesc.SourceString: <HermesSellDesc>您是否确定解锁该角色时装?</>
SellDesc.LocalizedString: <HermesSellDesc>Are you sure you want to buy this outfit?</>

Desc.SourceString: 空气本身是没有味道的，我们闻到的气味实际上是细小的分子，而现在这清新，芬芳的气息来源于柑橘的果肉与油脂，就当作她赠予我们的礼物吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: The air itself is odorless; what we smell are tiny molecules. This fresh, fragrant scent comes from the pulp and oils of citrus fruits—consider it a gift from her.

Desc.SourceString:
这种偶然间寻得的古老技艺让珐格兰丝非常惊喜，它平静，简洁，淡雅，一如她安心研究时窗外的天气。
“何处觅芳影，烟岚云岫，再上雨花亭。”
Desc.LocalizedString:
Fragrans was thrilled to discover this ancient craft by chance, as tranquil and simple as the weather outside her window during her research.

"Where does fragrance linger? Among misty clouds and peaks, at the Rainflower Pavilion."

SellDesc.SourceString: <HermesSellDesc>您是否确定解锁该角色时装?</>
SellDesc.LocalizedString: <HermesSellDesc>Are you sure you want to buy this outfit?</>

Desc.SourceString:
珐格兰丝的医护装扮，无论她本人对这类穿着是否习惯，要做的事情都是一样的，治愈病患，抚平创痛。

【“请好好休息一下吧。”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
Fragrans' medical attire, whether she's accustomed to it or not, serves the same purpose: to heal and soothe.

"It's important for you to rest well."

Desc.SourceString:
跟随地图的指引，在科斯迷特的沙漠中寻找传说中的香氛原料，为了抵抗炎热的天气，珐格兰丝也换上了一身清凉的装扮。

【“跟着香气走吧，带着眼罩是看不见地图的。”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
Fragrans follows the map in search of mythic ingredients in the Cosmite desert. She has changed into a cooler outfit to endure the scorching heat.

“Follow the scent. You can't read maps with a blindfold on.”

Desc.SourceString:
斑斓的光芒从这座城市溢出，随着射灯的角度，映向漆黑的夜空。在那昙华般绽放的光幕中央，那道身影倾听着城市的声浪，也轻嗅着城市的味道。

【“误解，仇恨，暴力，这片土地不该一直被这些缠绕。”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
From myriad angles, the city's vivid lights streak into the night sky. In the center of the blooming light stands a figure listening to the sounds of the city and taking in its scents.

“Misunderstanding, hatred, violence... I must rid the world of such things.”

SellDesc.SourceString: <HermesSellDesc>您是否确定解锁该角色时装?</>
SellDesc.LocalizedString: <HermesSellDesc>Are you sure you want to buy this outfit?</>

Desc.SourceString:
珐格兰丝很喜欢冬日的雪夜，尤其是站在路灯下，仰望雪花一片片飘落。那片幽深的蓝却能孕育如此纯净的白，也许这就是自然的馈赠吧。

【“当雪花落在你的掌心，他们不是消失了，而是融入为了你身体的一部分。”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
Fragrans loves snowy winter nights. She often stands under a streetlight, gazing at the sky as snowflakes fall. To think such pure white comes from the deep blue sky - perhaps it is nature's gift.

“When snowflakes fall into your palm, they don't disappear; they become a part of you.”

SellDesc.SourceString: <HermesSellDesc>您是否确定解锁该角色时装?</>
SellDesc.LocalizedString: <HermesSellDesc>Are you sure you want to buy this outfit?</>

Desc.SourceString:
在沐春节到来之际，珐格兰丝以‘锦鲤’为主题设计了新的作战服。主色调为黑白，点缀一抹优雅的红，如同水墨画中跃出的一尾锦鲤。

【“说我像是水墨画中走出来的人吗？哎呀，能被当作古迹的再现，也不枉我花费不少时间设计这套作战服呢。”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
To celebrate Spring Blessing, Fragrans has designed a new combat uniform inspired by the koi fish. The mostly black and white uniform is accented with an elegant touch of red like a koi leaping out of an ink painting.

"Are you saying I look like I just walked out of a painting? Thank you. Being considered a personification of ancient art makes all the effort I spent designing this outfit worthwhile."

SellDesc.SourceString: <HermesSellDesc>您是否确定解锁该角色时装?</>
SellDesc.LocalizedString: <HermesSellDesc>Are you sure you want to buy this outfit?</>

Desc.SourceString:
永夜古堡背后的长廊通往一片花园，里面种植着无数奇异诡丽的植物。人们总是好奇，花园的主人珐格兰丝是如何将这些植物打理得如此繁茂的，却没有人敢真的上前询问。

【“这些植物的养料是什么？当然是我制作的培养剂了。唔？你的表情怎么有点失望？”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
The corridor behind the Castle of Eternal Night leads to a garden lush with countless strange and eerie plants. People often wonder how the mistress, Fragrans, keeps them so vibrant, but none dare to ask.

"How do I nourish the plants? My special cultivation agent, of course. Hm? Why do you look disappointed?"

SellDesc.SourceString: <HermesSellDesc>您是否确定解锁该角色时装?</>
SellDesc.LocalizedString: <HermesSellDesc>Are you sure you want to buy this outfit?</>

Desc.SourceString:
她是空中盛放的花朵，呵护着旅人穿过寒潮和雾雨，向着天际的太阳追寻。有她相伴的旅程里，再急骤的风暴，也会在温柔的芳菲中变得宁静。

【“一处栖霞的馥郁，一段旅行的流连。”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
As a floral guardian of the skies, she shields voyagers from chill and fog, always reaching for the sun. Her company turns any raging storm into peace.

"Fragrance in the sunset, a journey to savor."

SellDesc.SourceString: <HermesSellDesc>您是否确定解锁该角色时装?</>
SellDesc.LocalizedString: <HermesSellDesc>Are you sure you want to buy this outfit?</>

Desc.SourceString:
“光之弦”传承者、溯光派领袖、圣女珐格兰丝特有的服装。以花做冠，散落光辉，以蔓为铠，缚锁黑暗；纵然世界灾劫未尽，但她披荆执锐的身影，将会绽放不朽的希望。

【吾身化不败的花蕊，祈吾人之一族，溯光明，永盛放。】
Desc.LocalizedString:
Fragrans' exclusive attire as the heir to the "String of Light" and leader of the Lightbearers. She wears a radiant floral crown and is armored with vines that bind darkness. Even amidst ongoing calamities, her thorn-clad figure blooms with eternal hope.

"I am an eternal blossom, praying that we follow the light and thrive forever."

Mist Walker, the warrior from the nether realm, steps through the mist to lead wandering souls. Only the underworld flowers growing where calamity once struck can attest to her presence.

"Don't worry, I'm not a shaman. Only they are interested in capturing you."

Desc.SourceString:
人们都说，不会钓鱼的探险家不是一个好画师。
为了前往斯崔恩郊野人迹罕至的生态区进行实地采风，玛德蕾娜特意准备了这套野外活动套装。沿溪溯行，时而写生，时而垂钓，画板和鱼框都装满了收获。

【“好耶，上钩了！欸——别跑啊！看招，颜料泡泡！”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
It's been said that an explorer who can't fish isn't a true artist.
To visit the remote ecological zones in Strian's countryside for field sketches, Maddelena prepared this outdoor set. She journeys along the river, alternating between sketching and fishing, filling her canvas and fish basket.

"Yes! Got one! Don't run away! Taste my paint bubbles!”

绘师少女脸上是满是兴奋的笑容，从身边一掠而过。
飘逸的身姿，滑轮上闪烁的虹光，让人有点头晕目眩。

Her elegant figure and the flickering rainbow lights dazzle onlookers.
Whatever this whimsical girl does, it is always in the name of "gathering inspiration."

Desc.SourceString:
“所谓的侦探技巧呢，最重要的就是——”
“就是什么？”
“就是……呃，观察、总结、分析、实践！”
“就这？ 我还以为有什么秘诀。拍着胸脯说要第一个找出怪盗，可别变成说大话喽？”
“怪盗预告说啥时候行动来着？”
“……此时，此刻。”
“啊！那和大小姐你在这一起瞪眼也没用啦！大侦探这就出发去找线索了，回头见！”

注意看，一位端着咖啡杯的姑娘一会儿瞅瞅蒸汽机的模型，一会儿摸摸古代鲸鱼的化石，四处乱转，调皮而活泼——在这座复古风格的博物馆中，即将上演一出侦探与怪盗狭路相逢的好戏。
“哎，真不该一口气就答应下来，我哪有什么对付怪盗的经验嘛……”大侦探啜饮咖啡停不下来，其实有些惴惴不安。
令人如此苦恼的，正是眼前玻璃柜中的展品“伊卡洛斯装置”——以复古的蒸汽技术打造，催动精巧而复杂的机关，能神奇地让人飞起来的传奇道具——对超弦体玛德蕾娜来说并不适用，但对于喜欢收集没用东西的玛德蕾娜来说简直刚刚好。
某个知名“怪盗”已经发出了预告信，宣称“伊卡洛斯装置”必在众目睽睽之下被其夺走。因为正赶上购物节，预告信积压了半个多月，直到预告前一天才寄到博物馆。忧心不已的博物馆主人立刻请求乌尔比诺介入。
为了下个月的咖啡花销，以及背包中“全自动创意复古维多利亚蒸朋哥特纯手动机械拿铁摩卡浓缩奥瑞白压缩调制机”的维护费有着落，玛德蕾娜果断选择加入这场攻防大战。
然而……
Desc.LocalizedString:
"The most important ability of a detective is..."
"What is it?"
"Uh... Observing, summarizing, analyzing, and putting it into practice!"
"That's it? I expected some secrets. Don't forget you promised to catch the thief first."
"When is the thief planning to strike?"
"...Now."
"Oh! I better not waste time here! I'm off to find clues. See you!"

A girl with a coffee cup flits from a steam engine to an ancient whale fossil, exploring mischievously. In the retro museum, a battle between detective and thief is about to begin.
"I shouldn't have taken this job. I have no experience with thieves..." The detective nervously sips her coffee.
Her frustration centers around the exhibit in the glass case before her: the "Icarus Device." This legendary gadget, crafted with retro steam technology, uses intricate mechanisms to let a person fly—useless to Maddalena, but perfect for her quirky collection.
A notorious thief has issued a warning, vowing to snatch the Icarus Device in plain sight. Due to the bustling shopping festival, the warning arrives at the museum just a day before the scheduled heist. Desperate, the curator calls Urbino for help.
To cover her coffee expenses for the next month and the maintenance for her Fully Automatic Creative Retro Victorian Steampunk Gothic Hand-Operated Mechanical Latte Mocha Espresso Flat White Compression Modulating Machine, Maddalena jumps into action.
However...

令人如此苦恼的，正是眼前玻璃柜中的展品“伊卡洛斯装置”——以复古的蒸汽技术打造，催动精巧而复杂的机关，能神奇地让人飞起来的传奇道具——对超弦体玛德蕾娜来说并不适用，但对于喜欢收集没用东西的玛德蕾娜来说简直刚刚好。
某个知名“怪盗”已经发出了预告信，宣称“伊卡洛斯装置”必在众目睽睽之下被其夺走。因为正赶上购物节，预告信积压了半个多月，直到预告前一天才寄到博物馆。忧心不已的博物馆主人立刻请求乌尔比诺介入。
为了下个月的咖啡花销，以及背包中“全自动创意复古维多利亚蒸朋哥特纯手动机械拿铁摩卡浓缩奥瑞白压缩调制机”的维护费有着落，玛德蕾娜果断选择加入这场攻防大战。
然而……
Desc.LocalizedString:
"The most important ability of a detective is..."
"What is it?"
"Uh... Observing, summarizing, analyzing, and putting it into practice!"
"That's it? I expected some secrets. Don't forget you promised to catch the thief first."
"When is the thief planning to strike?"
"...Now."
"Oh! I better not waste time here! I'm off to find clues. See you!"

A girl with a coffee cup flits from a steam engine to an ancient whale fossil, exploring mischievously. In the retro museum, a battle between detective and thief is about to begin.
"I shouldn't have taken this job. I have no experience with thieves..." The detective nervously sips her coffee.
Her frustration centers around the exhibit in the glass case before her: the "Icarus Device." This legendary gadget, crafted with retro steam technology, uses intricate mechanisms to let a person fly—useless to Maddalena, but perfect for her quirky collection.
A notorious thief has issued a warning, vowing to snatch the Icarus Device in plain sight. Due to the bustling shopping festival, the warning arrives at the museum just a day before the scheduled heist. Desperate, the curator calls Urbino for help.
To cover her coffee expenses for the next month and the maintenance for her Fully Automatic Creative Retro Victorian Steampunk Gothic Hand-Operated Mechanical Latte Mocha Espresso Flat White Compression Modulating Machine, Maddalena jumps into action.
However...

【若有闲暇，她总会来到竹林里，那间属于自己的小屋。
窗外树影婆娑，竹叶间的交杂光斑打在昏黄的木地板上。
即使你陪伴在她身边，她也总是一言不发。
只是静静地，将一盏沏好的清茶推到你的手旁。】
Desc.LocalizedString:
Inspired by bamboo, this elegant outfit evokes a sense of peace, reflecting Lawine's longing for her homeland.

In her spare time, she often visits her cabin in the bamboo forest.
Sunlight filters through the bamboo leaves, casting patterns on the dim wooden floor.
Even with you by her side, she remains silent, quietly offering you a freshly brewed cup of tea.

皮革与金属的碰撞，充满了朋克色彩。
她的呐喊，将向世界发起反叛。

【“既然世界本就没有未来，那又何谈罪恶。”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
The outfit Lawine wore during a victory celebration for The Scissors. The clash of leather and metal is as punk as it gets. She screams at the world in rebellion.

"Since the world has no future to begin with, why speak of sin?"

Desc.SourceString:
早期欧泊风格的搜查官制服，衬出穿着者飒爽干练的气质。这套制服中，蕴藏着拉薇所珍视的过往回忆。

“想问我，是不是很憎恨欧泊？或许吧……”
摆弄着制服的衣角，拉薇自言自语着，沉入思绪的海洋中。
“……我真正憎恨的，是蒙蔽我们双眼的‘虚妄’。”
“不论是欧泊的我，还是现在的我。这一点，从未改变。”
Desc.LocalizedString:
An early version of the P.U.S investigator's uniform, designed to emphasize strength and competence. This uniform holds Lawine's treasured memories.

"Do you wonder if I truly resent P.U.S.? Perhaps..." Lawine murmurs, fiddling with the edge of the uniform, lost in thought.
"...But what I truly despise is the 'illusion' that blinds us."
"Whether in my P.U.S. days or now, that has never changed."

【夜幕下的城市里，暗影正疾驰。
无人得见她的身影，也无人察知她的话音。
“真是松懈过头……这样，就得手了。”
剪刀手第三执行者拉薇，再度向与她的信仰为敌者，送上刀锋。】
Desc.LocalizedString:
Beneath the flamboyant combat uniform lies Lawine's calm and rational heart. In the shadows, she strikes with lethal precision.

Under the night sky, a shadow races through the city.
No one sees her. No one hears her.
“You let your guard down... playing right into my hands.”
Lawine, the enforcer of The Scissors, strikes again against those who oppose her faith.

【“等一下，你哪只眼睛看到我高兴了？”】

Originally there to observe P.U.S. at the Apple Festival, Lawine ended up in a fairy tale play. Her usual calm exterior is betrayed by lively ears and a tail that give away her thoughts.

"Hold on, who said I was enjoying this?"

“远程控制端口接入，雷达系统全开，不要放过任何蛛丝马迹。”
在信的指挥下，一场有条不紊的抓捕行动正紧张地进行中。
不过，这次抓捕行动在开始之前，就早已结束了。
“你就是这次的抓捕对象吧。接下来，是你投降？还是，要让我动手？”
Desc.LocalizedString:
Nobunaga's exclusive P.U.S. Spec Ops suit blends steel and leather, yet his elegance and calm demeanor remain undiminished.

“Activate remote control and the radar system. Don’t let anything slip past.”
Under Nobunaga's command, a meticulous raid is underway.
However, the operation ended before it even began.
"You must be the target. So, will you surrender? Or will you make me do it?"

【明明是欢乐的海滨假日，信却独自一人躺在沙滩椅上，静静地看着蓝天。
是心情不好，或者发生什么事情了吗？信否认了这一点。
“我只是在思考我的未来，还有我的价值。”
“稍稍陪我一会儿吧。也许在你身边，我的信念会更加坚定。”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
The form-fitting swimwear and beach shorts, while simple, highlight Nobunaga's remarkable presence. In this brief respite, he seeks solitude, enjoying the sea breeze on his face.

Amidst the joyous seaside holiday, Nobunaga reclines alone on a beach chair, gazing at the sky.
Is something troubling him? When asked, he denies any issues.
"I'm just reflecting on my future and my worth."
"Stay with me for a bit, won't you? Perhaps your presence will strengthen my resolve."

Desc.SourceString:
以鹤为印象设计的服装，黑色的底色上绘制了两只白鹤，如同从墨色的松林间振翅起飞，并肩而行，追逐白日。
穿起这件衣服时，信感到十分怀念。在欧泊的搜查官课程中他学习过古代东方的军事思想——"鹤翼阵"曾经是他们的拿手好戏，这原本需要两名合作者高度配合，从两翼同时包夹敌人。如今，尽管缺少了合作者，但信已经能够将同样的战术运用于单人作战之中——

【“你们已经被我一个人包围了，快投降吧。”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
An outfit inspired by cranes, featuring two white cranes painted on a black background as if they are soaring from an inky pine forest, chasing daylight.
Nobunaga always feels nostalgic when he dons this outfit. During the P.U.S Investigator course, he learned ancient Eastern military strategies—"Crane Wing Formation" was once their forte, requiring two partners to flank the enemy from both sides. Even without a partner, Nobunaga has managed to adapt the same tactics for solo combat.

"I have you surrounded. Surrender now."

【“所谓混乱，不止是对旧规则的颠覆，更是未来新秩序的起源。”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
Nobunaga's street performance outfit shows his take on rock 'n' roll. Some say rock is about guitar solos, bass lines, and drum beats. Others see it as a spirit, a rebellion against hypocrisy, the city's voice, and a musical outcry. For Nobunaga, rock is a revolution, blending speed, power, and the bright burst of life.

"Chaos isn't just about overturning old rules; it’s the origin of a new order."

“I thought you and I were just like these two pieces, never truly able to touch one another.”

Desc.SourceString:
服装原型考据自昔日在夜间森林中行走的猎人，怪诞乖张的设计里蕴含着由内而外的时代张力。

【“来嘛来嘛，绯莎，就差你一个了！暗夜猎人——光是想想都觉得很适合你呢！”
“这身衣服不适合执行任务。”
“别那么古板嘛！来来来，要拍照了！”
“那……好吧。”

面对同伴们的揶揄，绯莎沉默许久。她知道这只是玩闹，无论行装怎么更替，自己的过去都无法被改变。
却不知为何，她的心头泛上了一丝遗失许久的温暖。】
Desc.LocalizedString:
The outfit is inspired by hunters who once roamed the forests at night. Its bizarre design embodies the tension of the era.

“Come on, Fuchsia. You're the only one left! The Nightstalker suits you perfectly!”
“This outfit is not suitable for carrying out missions.”
“Live a little, would you? Come on, it's photo time!”
“Uh... fine.”

Hearing her companions' teasing, Fuchsia remains silent for a while. She knows it's all in fun and that no matter how her outfit changes, her past remains unchanged.
Yet for some reason, she feels a long-lost sense of warmth in her heart.

【“砰！简单利落的结束，仅此而已。”】
Desc.LocalizedString:

"Bang! A swift, clean finish."

【“多亏这套衣服，悄悄接近小动物时基本不会被察觉……有趣的经历。”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
Fuchsia's outfit during the first Champion of Relaxation competition. Lightweight, comfortable, and cool, the outfit features brown and green tones that allow her to blend into her surroundings as she treks through rivers and mountains.

“Thanks to my outfit, I could sneak up on animals without being noticed... An interesting experience.”

【“引航者，若你是我的鹰眼，我便是你的鲨齿。像之前一样，我们共同夺得胜利吧！”】

【“何为‘武’，为何‘学武’，这些问题的答案很重要吗？我不在乎，不也走到了今天？”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
The realm of martial arts is supreme and pure. For a martial artist to break through in technique, they must first break through their mindset. Fuchsia does not entirely agree, but she secretly hopes to find the answers someday.

"What are martial arts? Why do we practice them? Are the answers really that important? I never cared about these questions, and look how far I've come."

如果你在奶茶店的街角遇到了熊，请不要惊慌，只要假装没看到她就行，她会在补充完糖分后自行离开。

If you spot a bear in a milk tea shop, don't panic. Just act like you didn't see her, and she'll leave once she's had her sugar fix.

"Sugar is really important... That candy shop seems popular... Hmmm..."

Desc.SourceString:
护目镜、战术头盔、迷彩作战服……因为引航者的邀请，伊薇特认真备齐了一名战术分析官应有的全套装备。虽然战场不同于研究所，但伊薇特充分发挥自己强大的分析与研究能力，为前方作战的同伴保驾护航。

【“战、战术分析官伊薇特前来报道……”
害羞柔弱的声音微微颤抖着。
“那个……引航者，伊薇特收集到的作战数据，帮到大家了吗？”
那双温柔熟悉的双手轻轻摩挲着她的额头。
紧张羞红的少女渐渐地平复了自己的心情，来自引航者的安抚似乎是一种最为神奇的特效药，无论面对什么，她都能变得勇敢而坚定。】
Desc.LocalizedString:
Goggles, tactical helmet, combat suit... At the Navigator's invitation, Yvette thoroughly equipped herself with all the gear a tactical analyst needs. Although the battlefield is nothing like the lab, Yvette utilizes her analytical and research skills to support her allies on the front lines.

"T-Tactical Analyst Yvette reporting for duty..."
Her shy, soft voice trembles slightly.
"Um... Navigator, did the combat data I collected help anyone?”
Those gentle, familiar hands softly brush her forehead.
The nervous, blushing girl gradually calms down. The Navigator's reassurance seems to be a magical remedy, empowering her to face anything with courage and resolve.

【“心跳节奏，60……78……110，状态良好，你可以出院了。”】

Worn by Yvette during clinical trials to research Collapse Syndrome, this uniform symbolizes the dedication of a meticulous scientist. For her, a solid heartbeat is always a positive sign.

"Heartbeat at 60... 78... 110. All looks good. You're ready for discharge."

Desc.SourceString:
白墨亲手设计的面包师制服。这套服装版型前卫，内衬舒适，只是，近来的他，却没什么机会穿上这套衣服。

【“嗨，你看，这款蓝莓奶酥面包色泽金黄，松软绵密，吃起来酸甜可口，是我亲自烘焙的哦。”
白墨曾悄悄潜入旗下的一家面包店内，作为普通的面包师辛劳了好几天。
看到人们微笑着品尝他烘焙的面包时，他的心中不禁油然而生一股喜悦之情。
至今，那段时光仍是他最美好的回忆之一。】
Desc.LocalizedString:
A baker's uniform designed by Bai Mo, featuring an avant-garde design and comfortable lining. However, he has rarely had the chance to put it on.

【“Look. This blueberry milk bread is golden on the outside with a soft and fluffy texture and a sweet and sour taste. I baked it myself. ”
Bai Mo once worked undercover in one of his bakeries for several days.
Seeing people enjoy the bread he has baked fills his heart with joy.
To this day, that remains one of his fondest memories.】

Desc.SourceString:
近未来风格的运动装，色彩鲜明，款式时尚。白墨在这套服装上，加入了不少独属于自己的小设计。

“呀，被你发现了！你也是来带我回去的吗？”
明明已被逼到穷途末路，白墨的脸上，却挂上了一抹狡黠的微笑。
“我可不是在偷懒，乌尔比诺需要一位自由的领袖。把我关在办公室里，可是最大的浪费。”
在你被他的演讲吸引注意的同时，他纵身一跃，用纯熟的街头跑酷技巧逃出了你的视野范围。
Desc.LocalizedString:
A futuristic sports outfit with bright colors and a sleek design. Bai Mo has infused it with his own unique touches.

"Oh, you've found me! Are you here to take me back as well?"
Although cornered, Bai Mo still bears a cunning smile.
"I'm not slacking off. The leader of Urbino must be free. Locking me in an office would be a huge waste."
As you're drawn in by his words, he leaps away, skillfully escaping your view with expert parkour.

Desc.SourceString:
运用了过去的草原民族服装元素进行设计，融合了白墨的个人巧思和创想。
以天为盖，以地为席，苍茫天地，四海为家——这样自由的生活正可谓白墨所追求的理想。

【“天高云阔，任我遨游，再没有比这更自由的感觉了！”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
Inspired by traditional prairie attire, this design showcases Bai Mo's unique creativity and vision. Bai Mo's ideal life embodies boundless freedom and natural harmony.

"With the endless sky above, I roam freely. There's nothing more liberating!"

Desc.SourceString:
《怪盗英雄》电影的改装款夜行衣，硬朗修身的设计很符合白墨对于美观、舒适的追求。只是，在加入了定制绷带和荧光眼镜后，闪亮的效果与其设计初衷相距甚远。

【镜子前的白墨正对自己的品味赞叹不已，可紧接着发生的事情却让他终 生 难 忘——“嗯，偶尔cos一下夜行侠也不错。欸——别抓着我啊，我可不是小偷！”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
A modified stealth suit inspired by the movie "Phantom Thief," with a sleek, fitted design that matches Bai Mo's taste for style and comfort. However, the added custom bandages and neon glasses kind of defeat the purpose.

Standing in front of a mirror, Bai Mo marvels at his style, but what happens next is unforgettable - “Hmm, cosplaying as the Phantom Thief once in a while isn't half bad. Hey! Let me go! I'm not a thief!”

"I'm just an ordinary player. Being the organizer is a tall tale! I've contributed to the arcade scene; now I want to be a contestant!"

Desc.SourceString:
在人头攒动的盟主选举现场，伴随着一阵强劲的音乐，一道绿色闪电驰骋而来。不同于往日浪迹街头的街舞小子、涂鸦大王，今日的白墨盛装出席，风度翩翩，但是他的嘴角依旧挂着那抹向往自由意志的标志性微笑。

【“如果我能连任的话，就一个月休三十天吧！”
面对台上台下浪潮般的欢呼与掌声，白墨不由得惊叹道。
“哟呵，大伙比我还要热情啊~”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
At the bustling alliance leader election, a streak of green lightning zips through to energetic music. Unlike his usual street dancer and graffiti king style, Bai Mo is dressed to the nines, looking dapper, yet his iconic smile still exudes a longing for freedom.

"If I am re-elected, we'll have 30 days of vacation each month!"
Bai Mo is taken aback by the tidal wave of cheers and applause.
"Wow, you're all more excited than I am!"

Desc.SourceString:
在惊魂节游行评选中以最高票数夺得最抽象奖的选手“万人迷南瓜头先生”，其真实身份是乌尔比诺联盟盟主——白墨！对于获得这个奖项，抽象之神实至名归！只是南瓜头似乎让他的方向感变差了，截止到目前，他还没有来领走属于自己的奖杯。

【“不好意思啊，刚刚冲刺到反方向了，现在应该还可以领奖吧？最抽象奖……？你们是不是评错人了？我难道拿的不是最具人气奖吗？”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
In the Spookfest parade, "Mr. Pumpkin Charmer" won the Most Abstract Award with the highest votes. His true identity? Urbino's leader, Bai Mo! A deserving win for the master of abstract! Yet, his pumpkin head seems to have thrown off his sense of direction; he still hasn’t picked up his trophy...

"My bad, dashed the wrong way. The award's still for me, right? Most Abstract... Award? Did you mix it up? Shouldn't it be Most Popular?"

Desc.SourceString:
白墨参加海滨竞速俱乐部冲浪比赛时穿着的服装。随性潇洒的牛仔背心搭配沙滩风冲浪短裤，配饰选择了挂在腰间的迷你音箱，即使在冲浪比赛中也能伴随着强劲的音乐出场！

【“哇呼——这就是飞驰于海面的感觉吗？真不赖啊！”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
Bai Mo's outfit for the Coastal Race Club surfing competition. It features a laid-back denim vest paired with beach-style surf shorts. A mini speaker hangs at his waist, ensuring powerful music accompanies him even on the waves!

"Yahoo—Is this what it feels like to speed across the ocean? Not bad at all!"

Desc.SourceString:
白墨作为乌尔比诺联盟的盟主，代言了联盟旗下娱乐集团发明的数字化直播设备，并缔造了一夜之间获得百万粉丝的直播界奇迹！如今，他的身份又多了一个——引领潮流的顶流主播。很显然，他对这个身份适应良好，并随时准备在这个世界掀起新的风暴。

【看看我，看看我，我不有趣吗？呃……吞噬注意力的怪兽，他们是这么形容我的？只要进入一次我的直播间，就会像上瘾一样根本离不开？】
【这怎么会是冒犯呢？这分明是最好的夸奖啊！！！】
Desc.LocalizedString:
As the leader of the Urbino Alliance, Bai Mo has endorsed the digital streaming equipment developed by the alliance's entertainment group. The result is a miracle in the streaming world - he gained a million followers overnight! He has now added another title to his name - the trend-setting top-tier streamer. Clearly, he has adapted well to this identity and is ready to stir up another storm in the world.

"Look at me, look at me! Am I not interesting? Uh... a monster that devours attention? Is that how they describe me? Once you start watching my stream, you can never live without it. Like, addiction?"
"How is that an insult? That's the best compliment I've ever received!!!"

"She is the black quill shading the world, the endless spectral fire, the eternal gleam between reality and illusion."

【“看看，我修的如何？还没有我这把扳手搞定不了的。”
“不过，你这辆车的零件磨损也太严重了。我说，你得珍惜你的伙计啊。”
“…好像在别的地方见过我？这个嘛，这座城市这么大，谁知道是在哪呢？你就别在意了。”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
Rumor has it that there is a highly skilled young man who shows up in the auto shop from time to time. No matter what the malfunction is or the age of a race car, as long as he repairs and tunes it, the vehicle's performance will be enhanced. Everyone praises his repair skills, but few inquire about his identity - this is exactly what he aims to achieve.

"Check out the repair. There's nothing my wrench can't fix."
"However, the parts are severely worn. You gotta take care of your car, buddy."
"Feel like you've seen me before? Well, it's a large city. Perhaps you have; perhaps you haven't. Don't overthink it."

A customized model of the Rebelflame, with a thunderbolt-shaped barrel through which electricity surges like a dragon. Its gunshot is as loud as its owner's reputation. Rumor has it that a single shot from this weapon shakes the land like thunder, echoing through the world.

The Scissors' long-standing tradition of welcoming newcomers with stories has evolved into a martial arts showcase, drawing listeners from all over. As the vice-captain and speaker for the assault team, he eagerly shares tales of the captain's exploits.
During one session, while recounting the Wasteland Thunder story for the 50th time, a young listener unexpectedly interrupts, requesting to hear the adventures of the Thunderous Dragon outsmarting criminals.
Just as he prepares to answer, a figure in a battle suit makes a dramatic entrance.
“P-Prepare for combat? Now? What's the mission, Captain?”
“Simply put, it's a battle of wits against criminals!”
After grabbing a bag of chips, the figure waves to the young listener.
“Seeing is believing! Today, you'll witness it firsthand!”

作为统帅，武将不可折服，她还要兑现折梅相见的约定。正如这把枪的名字“一剪梅”，再冷酷的冬雪下，梅花都将凌寒独立。
而在寒冬过后，归乡的初春之日也就不远了吧。】
Desc.LocalizedString:
A personalized Shadow Assault model, featuring plum blossom motifs and classical elements. It embodies legendary heroism and enduring pride, ready to confront any battle alongside its master.

"As snow falls in the dark, the battlefield is wrapped in a frigid embrace. As comrades fell, a lone general stood firm against the gale and snow. The sudden storm buried everything—including, perhaps, the plum tree.
Yet, as a leader, the general remained unyielding, determined to keep her promise beneath the plum blossom.
Surely, once winter passes, the arrival of spring is not far behind."

那时的黄金覆满大地，流沙之上，佳酿与蜜的歌谣口口传唱，歌不尽千年的繁盛时光。
而如今，

"I had never witnessed such a glorious era.
Gold covered the land. Above the shifting sands, songs of fine wine and honey were sung, a fragment of its endless glory.
But now,
the gilded masks remain elegant, the ancient power still commanding,
a shimmering brilliance from a distant past."

【卡丘世界的海底生态链是断裂的，在迁移而来的海洋生物中，只有鲨鱼活了下来。但鲨鱼却变得不再敏锐而强大，连嗅觉都逐渐丧失。人们只能借助仿生技术还原鲨鱼从前的模样。
在接到改装完成的“齿锋”后，绯莎不由得感叹每一个细节都还原得如此精妙。
“没什么大不了的，只是按照某条从深海打捞上来的亡鲨骨架等比例还原的。”
枪械改造师不以为然地挑了挑眉毛。
“深海？这个世界的海洋中存在着鲨鱼？”
“是啊，不过很遗憾，现在只剩下一条还活着了……听生命改良部的同事说它最近似乎变得无比狂躁。”
鲨鱼是一种独行而沉稳的生物，为什么会平白无故地变得狂躁？绯莎非常想知道鲨鱼狂躁的原因。】
Desc.LocalizedString:
A customized edition of the Sawtooth, inspired by the skeleton of a shark from old Earth. Equipped with high-performance light elements, recreating the might and solitude of the deep-sea beast.

Strinova's marine ecosystem is broken. Among the ocean's migratory creatures, only the sharks survived. Yet, they have lost their sharpness and strength, and even their sense of smell is fading. Bionic technology was needed to restore their former glory.
When Fuchsia received the modified Sawtooth, she couldn't help but admire the exquisite attention to detail.
"No big deal. It's only a scaled replica of a shark skeleton salvaged from the deep sea."
The gunsmith remarks with a nonchalant raise of his eyebrow.
"The deep sea? Are there still sharks out there?"
"Sadly, there remains just one... My colleague from Bionic Tech mentioned it's been extremely agitated lately."
Sharks are typically solitary and composed, so why this sudden agitation? Fuchsia is eager to uncover the reason behind the shark's unusual behavior.

Desc.SourceString:
这是白墨直播间出现过的无数宝贝之一，也是出镜率最高的一个。白墨使用这把造型奇特的武器进行战斗、演奏音乐、喊麦饶舌，偶尔也让它充当棒球棍，敲在当街发疯的真·瘾君子头上。粉丝们熟悉它就像熟悉白墨本人。

刚来，还没开播吧？！！！
今天会玩点什么，已经开始期待了！
在凌晨两点开直播，主播真有你的……
楼上弹幕笑死，那你还不是连滚带爬地来了？承认吧，你染上白墨了！
呃……什么意思？怎么只有把枪摆在这，主播人呢？
喂喂喂，你们看，直播间的标题变了……“主播请假，武器代播？”
？？？
逗我吧这是……但，基于你是白墨……就姑且看看你的枪能玩出点什么花样……
Desc.LocalizedString:
One of the many items Bai Mo uses in his livestreams and also the most frequently showcased. Bai Mo uses this uniquely designed weapon for combat, playing music, rapping, and occasionally as a baseball bat to knock sense into lunatics. Fans know it as well as they know the streamer himself.

Just got here. The stream hasn't started yet, has it?!!!
What's on the menu today? I can't wait!
Streaming at 2 in the morning? You've got guts...
LOL at the comment above. You're here, aren't you? Admit it, you're addicted to Bai Mo!
Uh... What's going on? Why is there only a gun here? Where is Bai Mo?
Hey, Look! The title of the stream changed... "Streamer on Leave, Weapon Taking Over?"
???
You've got to be kidding me... Since this is Bai Mo's stream... I guess I'll stick around and see what tricks the gun can pull off...

【瑰丽的宫廷剑士向着远方眺望。

Desc.LocalizedString:
The royal swordswoman, enchanting as a rose, gazes into the distance.
She sees nothing but carnage and rivers of blood.
The rose-decorated sword pierces an enemy's heart.
The rose is dyed in blood's hue; shadows cast wide their pall.
Her mind, like the breeze, wanders far, unconfined by any wall.
“For you alone, the flowers unveil their bloom; should they fade, what sorrow calls?”

【成为一线搜查官的米雪儿继承了上一代的意志，当一个警号重启的时候，那些可悲的罪犯应当颤抖，因为继承白虎意志的人，会将他们全部击溃，一个不留。
“里面的人给我听好了，你们已经被我一个人包围了！速速投降！”——米雪儿在行动中如此威吓着。
后来，她确实做到了这一点，仅凭一人将十余名犯罪分子尽数逮捕。
“我还以为看不到明天的太阳了，那小妮子是要吃人吗？”——犯罪分子筛糠一样颤抖地回忆着。】
Desc.LocalizedString:
Having become a frontline investigator, Michele carries with her the will of her father. When a badge number is reactivated, the pitiful criminals better tremble in fear, for the successor of the White Tiger will defeat every single one of them.

“Listen up! I have you surrounded! Surrender now!” Michele once intimidated suspects like this during operations.
And she kept her word, singlehandedly arresting over a dozen suspects.
"I thought I wouldn't see the light of day again. Was she going to devour us like a wild tiger?" a criminal recalls, trembling in fear.

Desc.SourceString:
【"前辈有好好注视过这片星空吗？”
“据说，每个人都有一颗属于自己的星辰，它在宇宙里孤独地等待着，希望有一个人能与它遥遥相望。”
“如果有一天，前辈遥望天际的时候发现了一抹别样的光芒，那大概就是前辈的星辰正在眨眼吧。”
“前辈问我的星辰在哪里？那……那是秘密。”

少女从未曾停止对夜空的追寻。
在无数个与星光对视的夜晚里，少女等待着那颗星星，自浩瀚渺茫的星海里捕捉属于自己的光芒。
有一天，星星眨眼了。
整片夜空都改变了颜色。】
Desc.LocalizedString:
"Have you ever truly looked at the starry sky?"
"I heard there is a unique star for everyone, waiting alone in the universe, hoping someone would gaze at it."
"If one day you see an unusual light in the sky, that's probably your star winking at you."
"Where is my star? Well... that's a secret."

The girl never stops chasing the night sky.
Through countless nights under the stars, she patiently waits for that one star in the vast galaxy to reveal itself.
One day, the star winks at her.
And the entire night sky changes its colors.

As the cups touch, producing a crisp sound, the girl smiles confidently.】

当午夜降临，真正的守护并非驱散黑暗，而是助人安然进入梦乡。

【第六赛季高级搜查令PLUS专属】

可装配勋章数：3
Desc.LocalizedString:
A guardian-class casing lovingly forged by Urbino's Cloudscape Gallery, its design inspired by ancient dream rituals. The top summons a blazing-eyed drake that devours nightmares and scatters ill omens; the lower section suspends a finely woven dreamcatcher that filters stray thoughts and absorbs mana.
When midnight comes, true protection isn't about banishing the dark — it's about guiding others safely into sleep.

Season 6 Advanced Warrant PLUS Exclusive

Medal slots: 3
